_readme: playhead-e8mg. Verbatim channel heads of the two feeds this device is
actually subscribed to, fetched 2026-08-19. A hand-written fixture proves
you parse what you EXPECTED; only publisher bytes prove you parse what
publishers emit — and these two carry the exact shapes a hand-written
fixture would have missed. Conan puts <image><link> BEFORE the channel
<link> and both hold siriusxm.com (the distributor, not teamcoco.com);
The Diary Of A CEO has NO channel <link> at all, only <image><link>, and
it holds the feed's own URL.
Capture recipe, so anyone can redo it:
Nothing inside the channel head is altered. Only the two closing tags are
appended, so the excerpt is a well-formed document with zero items.
